name: @keep-walking/qa-tests-f06

Drives the session public interface (createSession/sessionStep/selectors from @keep-walking/shared/session) and reads apps/client's own shipped modules by relative import (home/home-state.ts, onboarding/onboarding-step.ts, ui/interest-register.ts, copy/districts.ts, storage/*.ts, telemetry/*.ts) — never a dev unit test file, never apps/client internals not exported for this purpose. Same workspace-member shape as qa/tests/F04 and qa/tests/F05 (mirrors their package.json). Owner: qa-tester.
